meta.title: No-Smoking Zone Facilities and Related Laws
meta.description: Learn which facilities are designated no-smoking zones under Korea’s National Health Promotion Act, the related laws, the fines for smoking in a no-smoking zone, and no-smoking zones in apartment complexes.

title: No-Smoking Zone Laws
subtitle: Enforcement Rule of the National Health Promotion Act
intro: Below are the facilities designated as no-smoking zones and the related rules under the National Health Promotion Act. For each type of facility, you can check how much of it is a no-smoking zone and whether a smoking room may be installed.
translationNotice: This English version is a reference translation. If it differs from the Korean version, the Korean version prevails.
disclaimer: This information is for reference only. Please check the relevant laws for the exact legal text.
